guidance.statement: Revised FY27 constant currency revenue growth target to 1.5% to 3.0% Y-on-Y.
guidance.quote: we are changing our revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms.

guidance.statement: Maintained operating margin guidance at 20% to 22% for the financial year.
guidance.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains the same at 20% to 22% operating margin.

guidance.statement: Plans to build a team of 6,000 Frontier Engineers over the next few years.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to have 6,000 Frontier Engineers over the next few years.

achieved.claim: Delivered Q1 constant currency revenue growth of 2.4% Y-on-Y and 1.0% Q-on-Q.
AI services revenue reached 8.2% of total revenue in Q1.
Recorded $3.6 billion in large deals with 61% net new.
Achieved operating margin of 21.1% and free cash flow of $955 million.

pushback.concern: Reason for lowering revenue guidance and whether second half will meaningfully improve.
Irrational competitive pricing reported by peers and impact on Infosys.
Impending wage hikes and tapered growth impacting ability to hold 20-22% margin band.
AI productivity pass-throughs causing revenue deflation in existing portfolios.

output.tone_why: Management transparently lowered revenue guidance due to macro uncertainty while demonstrating clear confidence in margin targets.
